title.narrative: Pakistan Financial Inclusion and Infrastructure Project

description.narrative: The proposed development objective is to contribute to increasing access and usage of digital payments and other financial services for households and businesses in Pakistan. This will be done by: (a) improving market infrastructure and institutional capacity,(b) supporting the uptake and usage of Digital Payments and Financial Services and by (c) improving access to financial services for micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs).The project will seek to substantially increase access and usage of financial servicesby women and support women-owned MSMEs.
